title: NRO neutrino detectors used to target and down ET craft

tellings.quote: They didn't know the NRO had nutrino light detectors on them picking up the signature of the ET craft and knocking them down.

plain: The National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency that runs spy satellites, is said to have fitted satellites with detectors for neutrinos, tiny particles that pass through almost anything, so it could pick up the signature of alien spacecraft and "knock them down." This comes from the UFO disclosure campaigner Steven Greer, who tells it on Michels's show as something only insiders knew, without naming his source, and if true it would mean the government has been secretly shooting down visiting craft.
